title: Black Benny's funeral
summary: French played Black Benny's huge funeral with eight to ten bands and his drum carried; compared with Celestin and Henry Zeno.

story.theme_name: Brass bands, parades and jazz funerals
story.community_name: Jazz funerals: dirges, hot return, second line

blocks.x: What was the biggest funeral you think you ever played? What funeral do you think you ever played?
You played Black Benny's funeral? Well, what was that like?
Oh man, they had all the bands. All the bands. Everybody.
How many bands? About six. More than six. More than six? Oh man, yeah. They had around about eight or ten bands. I don't know who had a band.
Yeah, Henry Zeno. Yeah. That was another big one.
They tell me Celestine had one larger than that. Larger than that.
That's all Celestine had. He had two bands with fifteen men.
Oh, Black Benny had a gang of bands behind him. Some of them didn't play. They just walked on there with the instrument.
Why they had more brass bands then? They ain't got them now. They don't have any? I said they had more brass bands then they got now. Oh yeah.
What did they do with Benny's drum? Did they have that in the funeral? Yes sir.
Mark was gone but not forgotten. There was a sign on the drum, someone would be toasting the drum.
Somebody told me about that and I forgot about it. Well they paraded a long time didn't they? Yeah.
They start in the morning. It just ain't like it used to be. It just ain't like it used to be. A whole lot of different.
